scenario.summary: This article describes multiple Metasploit modules targeting vulnerabilities in Langflow and OpenCTI, providing unauthenticated remote code execution capabilities. In Langflow environments, successful exploitation allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code, access application secrets, pivot to cloud metadata services, and maintain persistence by injecting malicious code into the application's database.

meta.hypothesis: An attacker has exploited a code-injection vulnerability in Langflow to execute arbitrary Python code, resulting in interactive shell access and persistence through unauthorized modifications to the application database.

hunt.name: Langflow Host Impact and Persistence
hunt.description: This hunt targets the post-exploitation phase of multiple Langflow vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-0768, CVE-2026-0769, CVE-2026-10134). It follows a gated approach designed to minimize performance impact: an initial cheap scoping query identifies hosts running Langflow, and only then are deeper, more expensive queries triggered to find rare Python-to-shell process relationships and suspicious datastore activity. By correlating rare child processes with database-level tampering, the hunt identifies persistence mechanisms that standard detection rules often overlook.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, install_path FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%langflow%'
config.description: Identify hosts where Langflow is present to narrow the focus of expensive behavioral queries.
config.expected_signal: Rows indicating hosts with Langflow installed. Absence means Langflow is not installed via standard package managers.

primitive_config.label: Identify Langflow installations
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, install_path FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%langflow%'
primitive_config.expected: Rows indicating hosts with Langflow installed. Absence means Langflow is not installed via standard package managers.

config.objective: Determine if Langflow is installed on any hosts and identify those hosts for the next phase.
config.description: Determine if any hosts in the environment are running Langflow, justifying further investigation.
config.expected_signal: A verdict confirming the presence of Langflow and a list of target hostnames.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of present or absent with a list of hostnames.

config.question: the evaluate-langflow-exposure verdict is present
config.description: Terminate the hunt if the target application is not found, saving resources.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, LOWER(process_name) AS proc, LOWER(parent_process_name) AS parent, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%python%' AND LOWER(process_name) IN ('sh', 'bash', 'zsh', 'cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'pwsh') AND instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, proc, parent HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
config.description: Detect Python RCE by identifying rare parent-child pairs where Python launches a shell, restricted to Langflow hosts.
config.expected_signal: Rare shell launches from Python on the Langflow hosts. Benign activity like developer scripts will typically be frequent across several days or hosts.

primitive_config.label: Rare Python shell spawns
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, LOWER(process_name) AS proc, LOWER(parent_process_name) AS parent, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%python%' AND LOWER(process_name) IN ('sh', 'bash', 'zsh', 'cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'pwsh') AND instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, proc, parent HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
primitive_config.expected: Rare shell launches from Python on the Langflow hosts. Benign activity like developer scripts will typically be frequent across several days or hosts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, activity_name, message, time FROM hb_datastore_activity WHERE (LOWER(message) LIKE '%tool_code%' OR LOWER(message) LIKE '%secrets%' OR LOWER(message) LIKE '%langflow%') AND instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Detect persistence or secret theft by identifying SQL operations targeting Langflow's internal fields, restricted to relevant hosts.
config.expected_signal: Audit logs showing updates to 'tool_code' or reads from 'secrets' tables on Langflow hosts.
